subject: stf
title: STF.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 310 (WI-26). STF (source transfer) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CULT-SOLD: RE-ST (restructuralism). From T-C-IMP: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From RE-ST: IST-F (isolated focus). From AFL-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information) and AF-CON (affinity convergence). From AF-CON: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition).
